name: Microsoft SharePoint
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Sites.Read.All, and Sites.ReadWrite.All to add and edit list items; the token address holds your directory ID.

endpoints.name: search_sites
endpoints.description: Finds SharePoint sites by keywords in search; without search, lists every site. A site’s id is the site_id the other tools take.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_site
endpoints.description: Returns one site, by the id search_sites gives, or the root site when site_id is root.

endpoints.name: list_subsites
endpoints.description: Lists the subsites of a site.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_lists
endpoints.description: Lists a site’s lists; system lists stay hidden unless select includes system.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_list
endpoints.description: Returns a list’s metadata, by its id or its title; expand=columns adds its columns.

endpoints.name: list_columns
endpoints.description: Lists a list’s columns; a column’s name, not its displayName, is its key in an item’s fields.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_list_items
endpoints.description: Lists a list’s items; expand=fields adds their column values, fields(select=Title,Status) only some. filter takes fields/Status eq 'Open' (eq, ne, lt, gt, le, ge, startswith) on indexed columns only: Graph refuses any other column unless sent a Prefer: HonorNonIndexedQueriesWarningMayFailRandomly header, which this tool cannot send.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_list_item
endpoints.description: Returns one list item; expand=fields adds its column values.

endpoints.name: list_libraries
endpoints.description: Lists a site’s document libraries; a library’s id is the drive_id the file tools take.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_library_files
endpoints.description: Lists the files and folders at the top of a document library; a folder’s id is the driveItem_id list_folder_files takes.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_folder_files
endpoints.description: Lists the files and folders in a folder of a document library.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: search_content
endpoints.description: Searches SharePoint for files, list items, sites, lists or libraries (entityTypes driveItem, listItem, site, list, drive); queryString takes KQL (budget filetype:xlsx) and region, your data location code (NAM, EUR, …), is required. Body: {"requests": [{"entityTypes": ["driveItem"], "query": {"queryString"}, "region": "NAM", "from": 0, "size": 25}]}.

endpoints.name: create_list_item
endpoints.description: Adds an item to a list. Body: {"fields": {"Title", …}}, each key a column’s name from list_columns.

endpoints.name: update_list_item
endpoints.description: Changes the given column values of a list item and leaves the rest alone. Body: {"<column name>": value, …}.
